latest.title: Finite-Time Singularities of the Kähler--Ricci Flow on Fano Bundles
latest.abstract: We study collapsing finite-time singularities of the unnormalized Kähler--Ricci flow on Fano bundles arising in the analytic minimal model program. For a Fano bundle $X^n\rightarrow Y^m$, we prove a maximal splitting theorem by the Kähler-Ricci flow that every tangent space at a fixed limiting point splits globally as \((\C^m,g_{\rm E},J_0)\times(Z',d',J')\). If the fibre has complex dimension one, we prove a global Type-I bound for the full curvature tensor and show that the ambient and intrinsic diameters of every fibre are uniformly comparable to \(\sqrt{T-t}\). Furthermore, every tangent flow at any fixed limiting point is the round shrinking cylinder \(\C^m\times\PP^1\).
latest.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
latest.workSummary: 对射影流形间的 Fano 丛证明固定极限点处切向流模型全局分裂出全部复基底方向；P1 丛情形进一步获得整体 Type-I 全曲率界和精确纤维直径收缩率。
techniques: 加权漂移谱隙与全纯分裂
固定纤维捕获与双尺度反证
latest.breakthrough: 把部分标量/局部控制推进到相对复维一的全曲率与圆柱切向流分类，支持解析极小模型纲领的塌缩图景。
latest.limitations: 需极限类由基底 Kähler 类拉回且保留局部平凡性；高相对维的 Type-I 与一般变化 Fano 纤维仍属猜想，圆柱唯一性忽略热测度标记。
latest.aiEvidence: 作者在致谢中明确说明 GPT-5.6-sol 协助第 3 节的发展与表述，并提示了 He–Ou 的工作；本文证明不依赖该被提示结果。
latest.priorityReason: Kähler–Ricci 流有限时塌缩的核心进展，基底维数不受二复维限制；已核对主定理、技术路线、结论边界与披露。
